items.title: Implement patch-bump of the 3 version sync points in the DONE post-merge effect, gated on material code changes, before the dist rebuild, under the merge-lock
items.context: done-effects.ts: reuse isDoneMainRuntimeBuildInput/shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths to gate; bump root package.json + packages/main/package.json + lattice-brand.ts LATTICE_CLI_VERSION patch; commit on main; ordering before runDoneMainPackageBuildAfterMerge so rebuilt dist reports the new version

happy.desc: parseSemver(1.2.3) returns {major:1,minor:2,patch:3}; WHY: validates the fundamental parse that all other functions depend on
nextPatch({major:0,minor:3,patch:9}) returns {major:0,minor:3,patch:10}; WHY: confirms patch-only increment, minor/major untouched
readSyncedVersion(fixtureRoot) with all 3 sync points at 0.9.9 returns 0.9.9; WHY: proves 3-point read + sync assertion pass when versions match
applyPatchBump(fixtureRoot) with all 3 sync points at 0.9.9 writes 0.9.10 to all 3 files and returns {from:0.9.9,to:0.9.10}; WHY: end-to-end FS mutation of all 3 sync points

bumpVersionOnDoneMerge({shouldBump:true, runGit:spy}) bumps files, calls git add on 3 paths + git commit with chore:bump, returns success line containing auto-bumped; WHY: full orchestration path including git interaction
bumpVersionOnDoneMerge({shouldBump:false}) returns skip line containing skipped, no filesystem changes; WHY: gate-off path must be inert

edge.desc: parseSemver(0.0.0) returns {0,0,0} and nextPatch returns {0,0,1}; WHY: zero-boundary patch increment from floor value
nextPatch on patch=999 returns patch=1000 with no overflow cap; WHY: large patch number boundary
parseSemver rejects 1.2 (missing patch) and v1.2.3 (v-prefix) and 1.2.3-beta (prerelease) and abc (non-numeric); WHY: strict X.Y.Z enforcement prevents silent corruption
readSyncedVersion with root=0.3.9 main=0.3.9 brand=0.3.10 throws drift error naming each value; WHY: drift detection prevents silent desync
applyPatchBump re-read verification: after writing re-reads all 3 files and confirms identical version; WHY: write-then-verify guards against partial write

shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths([packages/main/src/x.ts]) returns true and [.lattice/story/B-x/index.json] returns false; WHY: gate predicate correctly distinguishes material vs metadata paths

adversarial.desc: readSyncedVersion when lattice-brand.ts has LATTICE_CLI_VERSION on multiple lines (duplicate export) throws or reads the canonical one; WHY: adversarial file content with ambiguous version source

applyPatchBump called on a fixture where root package.json is read-only (chmod 0444) throws with a clear error and does not partially update the other 2 files; WHY: partial-write atomicity under filesystem permission failure

bumpVersionOnDoneMerge where runGit(commit) throws after files already written: error propagates with recovery message mentioning manual 3-point sync; WHY: git failure after FS mutation must surface recovery instructions

applyPatchBump called twice consecutively on same fixture: first bumps 0.9.9 to 0.9.10, second bumps 0.9.10 to 0.9.11 (not 0.9.12, no double-bump); WHY: idempotency -- each call reads current state, never accumulates

items.title: Smoke test: bump fires on material-code merge, skips metadata-only merge, syncs all 3 points to the same new patch, is patch-only (idempotent, no double-bump)
items.context: new task smoke under packages/main/src/tasks/; assert the 3 points read identical bumped patch; assert .lattice-only change set does NOT bump; assert minor/major unchanged
